reason: A DeepSeek Harness integration plugin that manages remote HTTP and local stdio MCP servers, authentication, workspace configuration, and MCP tool registration through a Settings page.

summaries.zh: 通过设置页面管理远程 HTTP 和本地 stdio MCP 服务器、认证、工作区配置及工具注册。
summaries.en: Manage remote HTTP and local stdio MCP servers, authentication, workspace configuration, and tool registration from a DeepSeek Harness settings page.

capabilities: Connects to remote MCP servers over HTTP
Performs OAuth authorization with PKCE and stores refreshable OAuth state
Reads bearer tokens and custom header values from environment variables
Launches and manages local stdio child processes
Reads and writes global and workspace MCP configuration files
Registers and dispatches MCP tools to DSH sessions
